<translate>
'''Gomah's Horn Cradle''' is a floating island of red ash and demon rock, about 120 blocks across, high above the First Demon World of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. Giant curved horns rise from beneath it up toward the rock ceiling, caging the island. King [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]] sits on a demon-brick throne in the middle.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gomah ==
</translate>
{{Main|Gomah}}
<translate>
[[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]] is the Demon Realm's strongest [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|world boss]]. His lair is only set up once the Horn Cradle has generated. His [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Eye|Demon Eye]] makes him stronger and bigger the longer the fight lasts: hit him from behind to knock it loose.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it ==
</translate>
<translate>
The Horn Cradle generates once per world at a fixed spot, around X −1112, Z −1144, high in the sky of the First Demon World. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Time Patroller|Time Patroller]] in every [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Village|demon village]] sells a '''Gomah's Horn Cradle Map''' for 24 Emeralds (4 uses). Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate gomah_cradle}} in the Demon Realm.
</translate>
